en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of the divine preceptor
One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of the divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾਂ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਜੁਹਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: satigur sachaa paatisaahu paatisaahaa(n) paatisaahu juhaaree|

en.bdb: I salute the true Guru who is the true king of kings.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚਿ ਖੰਡੁ ਹੈ ਆਇ ਝਰੋਖੈ ਖੋਲੈ ਬਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat sach kha(n)dd hai aai jharokhai kholai baaree|

en.bdb: The Holy congregation is the abode of truth where the gates of mind are opened.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਮਿਉ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਨਿਝਰ ਝਰੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਨਾਦ ਵਾਇਨਿ ਦਰਬਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: amiau kiran nijhar jharai anahadh naadh vain dharabaaree|

en.bdb: The fountain of nectar flows here forever and the courtiers play the unstruck melody.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਮਜਲਸੈ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਪੀਵਣ ਭਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: paatisaahaa(n) dhee majalasai piram piaalaa peevan bhaaree|

en.bdb: In the assembly of the kings it is very difficult to drink the cup of love.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਪੀਲਾਵਣਾ ਉਲਸ ਪਿਆਲੈ ਖਰੀ ਖੁਮਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: saakee hoi peelaavanaa ulas piaalai kharee khumaaree|

en.bdb: The Guru becomes the beloved butler and makes one drink it, the delight of His tasted cup becomes multiplied.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਚਲਣਾ ਮਸਤ ਅਲਮਸਤ ਸਦਾ ਹੁਸਿਆਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: bhai bhagat bhai chalanaa masat alamasat sadhaa husiaaree|

en.bdb: Whosoever moves in the fear of loving devotion, he being carefree of the worldliness remains alert.
Kind to the devotees, God, becomes their caretaker and fulfils all their desires.
